mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School and the moon is in its Third Quarter phase.

Mayor Diaz has officially designated October as Community Planning Month, highlighting the Planning and Development Department's expertise in navigating city growth. Also, keep an eye out for potential mail from the Water Utility regarding upcoming cross connection surveys to help keep our water supply safe.

We have a busy schedule ahead with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at both Hop Haus Brewing and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia and live music throughout the week and the downtown farmer's market on October 7.
Regarding local safety, on September 21, a retailer in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue reported a theft of candy, and police identified and cited the individual responsible.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is closed right now but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
